t: Din im yesh techumin lemala measara tepachim
s: Din im yesh techumin lemala measara tepachim ubo d' seipim: hamhallek chutz lattechum lemala mi' tepachim, kegon sheqqapatz al gabbe ammudim sheggebohim y' tepachim veen bekol echad mehem d' tepachim al d' tepachim, o apillu ammud echad gaboah veen bo d' tepachim al d' tepachim, sheomed miqtzato betok hattechum umiqtzato chutz lattechum, umehallek al gabbo missepato el sepato — hare zeh sapeq im yesh techumin lemala mi' tepachim o lav, mippene sheepshar shehilluk gaboah y' tepachim eno niqra hilluk. Abal ammud sheyyesh bo d' tepachim al d' tepachim, kevan shennoach tashmish halikato, en bo sapeq shehilluk gamur hu, vahare zeh kimhallek baaretz, sheroin et haammud keillu hu miggup haaretz, shehi aba kan uboletet kemo ammud. Abal pachot mid' tepachim, kevan sheeno noach lehallek bo — hare zeh kimhallek baavir, veyesh bo sapeq. Veken hamhallek biqpitza al yede shem lemala mi' tepachim. Veken sepina haholeket lemala mi' tepachim miqqarqait hammayim doma liqpitza baavir, kevan sheenah nacha bahalikatah al haaretz kemo shennach adam haholek beraglayv:

Vesapeq zeh — en holekin bo lehachamir ella beshel tora, kegon mittok y"b mil lechutz ley"b mil ledibre haomerim shettechum y"b mil hu min hattora. Vehu sheyyihyu kol hay"b mil reshut harabbim gemura min hattora, al derek shennitbaer besimman shm"h, kede sheyyihyu domim ledigle midbar shehayu reshut harabbim gemura, shemmishsham lamedu issur hattechumim min hattora, kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"v. Abal im chaser echad mittenae reshut harabbim beinyan shemmin hattora muttar letaltel bekullo — en tzarik lomar shemmuttar lehallek bekullo. Ukebar nitbaer besimman shm"h shennahagu kehaomerim sheakshav en lanu reshut harabbim gemura:

Abal keshessapeq zeh hu beshel dibrehem, holekin bo lehaqel. Vehoil veen bayyammim ubanneharot issur techumin shel tora ledibre hakkol apillu beyoter mi"b mil, lepi sheenan domim ledigle midbar, lepikak mi shebba bispina beshabbat vehiggia lenamal — im mishshenniknas hashshabbat ad shehiggia lenamal leolam hayeta mehalleket lemala mi' tepachim miqqarqa hayyam o hannahar, en lo din yotze chutz lattechum sheen lo ella d' ammot, lepi sheadayin lo qana shebita, ubemaqom sheppaga bo lematta mi' tepachim samuk lenamal — sham hu qoneh shebita, veyesh lo alpayim lekol ruach. Vaapillu im hu sapeq im hayeta mehalleket lemala mi' tepachim holekim lehaqel. Abal im yadua shehayeta bemaqom echad lematta mi' tepachim mishshenniknas hashshabbat, vehipliga mishsham chutz lealpayim — en lo mishsham ella d' ammot kedin yotze chutz lattechum, shehare qana kebar shebita bemaqom shehayeta lematta mi' tepachim. Ella shekkol hassepina nechshebet lo ked' ammot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"[h]. Veen tzarik lomar im yatza paam echad layyabbasha mammash mishshechasheka. Umikkol maqom im hu beinyan shemmuttar lo latzet min hassepina lenamal velikkanes lair, kegon shehaggeshamim yoredim alayv o shehachamma zorachat alayv umetzaarto, o shetztzarik linqabayv veen lo maqom tzanua ad sheyyikkanes lair, shemmuttar lo likkanes, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"v — hare kol hair lo ked' ammot im hi muqqepet mechitztzot ledira, umehallek et kullah, kevan shenniknas letokah birshut. Vehu haddin im niknas beones, kegon sheddechapuhu nokrim letok hair. Veen tzarik lomar im niknesa hassepina atzmah letok hair, shehi chashuba ked' ammot im muqqepet ledira. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehipliga chutz lattechum mehammaqom shehayeta sham lematta mi' tepachim. Abal im adayin lo hipliga meoto maqom alpayim, veniknesa lair, vekolta middato bachatzi hair — asur lehallek yoter mechetzyah, ap al pi shenniknas lah birshut, lepi sheen hair nechshebet ked' ammot ella leyotze chutz lattechum, abal lo lemi shemmoded alpayim mimmeqom shebitato, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"g:

Habba beshabbat michutz lattechum, muttar lelek beyom tob shelleacharayv chutz led' ammot, mippene sheshte qedushshot hen, veen bezeh issur hakana mishshabbat leyom tob bemah shemmehallek kan beyom tob yoter mid' ammot al yede shekkebar qana kan shebita beshabbat, hoil ubishat qeniyyato shebita kan beshabbat lo amar kelum:
